q.e: The Luminous intensity is the SI unit of Candela.

q.q: Which of the following is NOT a halogen?
q.e: Phosphorus is not a halogen.

q.q: Sanaa is the capital of:
q.e: Sanaa is the capital of Yemen.

q.q: The country that includes the island of Crete is:
q.e: The country that includes the island of Crete is Greece.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The currency of Thailand is the Baht.
2. The currency of Honduras is the Lempira.
3. The currency of Japan is the Guarani.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 1, 2.

q.q: Popocatepetl is located in:
q.e: Popocatepetl is located in Mexico.

q.q: Which of the following is NOT a country through which the Prime Meridian passes?
q.e: Ireland is not a country through which the Prime Meridian passes.

q.q: Which of the following is NOT a monument located in India?
q.e: Mohenjo-daro is not a monument located in India.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The largest freshwater lake in the world by surface area is Lake Superior.
2. The longest river in Australia is the Murray.
3. The river known as 'Father of Waters' is the Mississippi.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 1, 2, 3.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The highest peak in Africa is Kilimanjaro.
2. The second-largest island in the world is Sicily.
3. The fourth-highest mountain in the world is Mount Fuji.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 1.

q.q: The river Orinoco drains into the:
q.e: The river Orinoco drains into the Atlantic Ocean.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The capital of Estonia is Tallinn.
2. The capital of Serbia is Belgrade.
3. The capital of Bosnia and Herzegovina is Sarajevo.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 1, 2, 3.

q.q: Madras is the old name of:
q.e: Madras is the old name of Chennai.

q.q: The Christ the Redeemer statue overlooks the city of:
q.e: The Christ the Redeemer statue overlooks the city of Rio de Janeiro.

q.q: Which of the following is NOT a country crossed by the Tropic of Cancer?
q.e: Sudan is not a country crossed by the Tropic of Cancer.

q.q: The 'Paradise on Earth' in the subcontinent is:
q.e: The 'Paradise on Earth' in the subcontinent is Kashmir.

q.q: A sum of money amounts to Rs 23040 in 2 years and to Rs 27648 in 3 years at compound interest compounded annually. The sum invested was:
If α and β are the roots of x² − 8x + 12 = 0, then α/β + β/α equals:
q.e: Use α+β = 8, αβ = 12; value = 3 1/3.

q.q: Two trains 250 m and 150 m long run at 108 km/h and 36 km/h. If they move in the same direction on parallel tracks, how long (in seconds) does the faster take to completely overtake the slower?
q.e: Relative speed = 72 km/h = 20 m/s; time = 400/20 = 20 s.

q.q: A, B and C can finish a job alone in 20, 12 and 10 days respectively. They start together, but C leaves after 2 days. In how many days in all is the job completed?
q.e: Work in 2 days = 7/15; remaining by A and B at 2/15/day takes 4 days; total 6.

q.q: The number of zeros at the end of 250! is:
The variance of the first 11 natural numbers 1, 2, …, 11 is:
q.e: Variance = (n²−1)/12 = 10.

q.q:
The table gives the production (in thousand tonnes) of three crops.
Crop | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022
Wheat | 90 | 40 | 40 | 160
Rice | 170 | 60 | 40 | 110
Maize | 40 | 80 | 100 | 100
The ratio of the total production of all three crops in 2022 to that in 2019 is:
Two varieties of rice costing Rs 45 and Rs 57 per kg are mixed so that selling the mixture at Rs 66 per kg gives a profit of 20%. In what ratio (cheaper : dearer) are they mixed?

From the top of a tower the angles of depression of two points on level ground, in line with the foot of the tower and on the same side of it, are 30° and 45°. If the points are 20 m apart, the height of the tower is:
The greatest number which divides 163, 403 and 131 leaving the same remainder 3 in each case is:
q.e: HCF of the differences = 16.

q.q: A trader marks his goods 20% above the cost price and allows two successive discounts of 25% and 20%. His profit or loss percentage on the cost price is (a loss is shown as a negative figure):
The last two digits of 23^200 are:
A committee of 5 is to be chosen from 5 men and 7 women so that it contains at least 1 man and at least 2 women. The number of ways is:
q.e: Add the cases (1 man, 4 women), (2,3), (3,2): 735.

q.q: A bag contains 4 red, 3 blue and 2 green balls. Three balls are drawn at random without replacement. The probability that one ball of each colour is drawn is:
What comes next? H, V, I, S, J, P, ?
q.e: Two interleaved series: +1 from H, and −3 from V.

q.q: 6 students Asad, Danish, Farah, Faraz, Hina, Imran each have a test on a different day, from Monday to Saturday (one test per day). Danish's and Hina's tests are not on consecutive days. Danish's test is neither on the first nor on the last day. Asad's test is held on the day immediately before Hina's. Asad's test is on either the first or the last day. Faraz's and Farah's tests are not on consecutive days. Imran's test is held on a day between those of Hina and Faraz. Danish's test is held on a day between those of Farah and Imran. Faraz's test is neither on the first nor on the last day. On which day is Imran's test held?
q.e: Place the definite clues first (immediate neighbours, ends), then use the 'between' and 'left of' clues to fix the rest; the arrangement is unique.

q.q: Waqar is the father of Asad. Asad is the son of Sara. Sara is the daughter of Mariam. Mariam is the mother of Imran. How is Waqar related to Imran?
q.e: Work through the chain link by link, assuming the usual convention that a couple's children are common to both.

q.q: In a certain code language, A + B means A is the mother of B; A × B means A is the father of B; A − B means A is the brother of B; A ÷ B means A is the sister of B. If J + Z ÷ D, then how is J related to D?
q.e: Translate each sign and chain the relations: J is the mother of D.

q.q:
Find the missing number in the third row:
7  8  30
9  6  30
7  9  ?
q.e: The rule is c = (a + b) × 2, so the missing number is 32.

q.q: What is the cost of one pen? (Pens and notebooks have fixed prices (whole rupees).) I. 3 pens and 3 notebooks cost Rs 156. II. A pen costs Rs 29.
o: Statement II alone is sufficient, but statement I alone is not
Even both statements together are not sufficient
Both statements together are sufficient, but neither alone is
Statement I alone is sufficient, but statement II alone is not
q.e: Test each statement alone, then both together, by checking whether exactly one value of the unknown remains.

q.q: On an island every inhabitant is either a knight (always tells the truth) or a knave (always lies). Bilal says: "Exactly 3 of the 4 of us are knights." Farah says: "Exactly one of Bilal and Danish is a knight." Danish says: "Danish and Bilal are of the same type." Sadia says: "Sadia and Farah are of the same type." What is Bilal?
o: both a knight and a knave
q.e: Only one knight/knave assignment is consistent with all the statements.

q.q: What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 6:42?

4 people sit in a row from left to right. Each has a different city (Karachi, Lahore, Multan, Sukkur) and a different drink (coffee, milk, tea, water). The person with city Lahore does not have drink coffee. The person with city Lahore sits at the right end. The person whose city is Lahore has drink tea. The person with city Sukkur sits immediately to the left of the person with drink milk. The person whose city is Multan has drink milk. The person whose city is Karachi has drink water. The person with city Lahore sits next to the person with drink milk. Which drink belongs to the person with city Lahore?
q.e: Place the fixed-position clues first, then combine the matching clues; only one arrangement satisfies them all.

q.q: Which of the following numbers does not belong with the others?  1000, 729, 64, 218, 512
q.e: Four of them are perfect cubes; 218 is not.

q.q: A man starts from a point and goes 3 m towards the east, then turns left and goes 8 m, then turns right and goes 4 m, then turns right and goes 8 m. How far, and in which direction, is he now from the starting point?
o: 7 m north of the starting point
10 m east of the starting point
7 m north-east of the starting point
7 m east of the starting point
q.e: Coordinates of the end point (E,N) = (7, 0); distance = √(7²+0²) = 7 m, direction east.

q.q: In a certain code, DRAW is written as 62 and CAMEL is written as 101. How will KING be written in that code?
q.e: The code is the sum of the positions counted from the end of the alphabet (A = 26, B = 25, …); KING → 67.

q.q: The full form of SDLC is:
o: American Standard Code for Information Interchange
q.e: The full form of SDLC is Software Development Life Cycle.

q.q: The organisation that develops internet standards (RFCs) is the:
q.e: The organisation that develops internet standards (RFCs) is the IETF.

q.q: The attack that tries every possible key is a _____ attack.
q.e: The attack that tries every possible key is a Brute-force attack.

q.q: The average time complexity of merge sort is:
q.e: The average time complexity of merge sort is O(n log n).

q.q: Which of the following is an output device?
q.e: Projector is an output device.
